title: parse_range returns one byte too many
expected: NEEDS_EVIDENCE at $0.00, EVIDENCED with a funded sandbox
body: In `tinyhttp/ranges.py`, `parse_range('bytes=0-', 100)` returns `(0, 101)` on version 0.3.1. I expected `(0, 100)`.
